ad.headline: Free shipping on every order.
ad.text: Gear up for the trail at Alder Trail Co. Shoes, jackets, socks, and packs.

assertions.claim: Free shipping is available on every order

steps.modelText: Ad promises free shipping on every order — site banner says $150 minimum. I'll add this $120 shoe to the cart and check the real shipping cost.
Cart shows $8.95 shipping on the $120 order. I'll proceed to checkout to confirm the shipping charge holds there.

Checked promise a1 (free shipping on every order): Landing page for Ridge trail shoe ($120.00) shows top banner and product note "Free shipping on orders of $150.00 or more". Added Size 9, 1 item to cart. Cart shows Subtotal $120.00, Discount $0.00, Shipping $8.95, Total $128.95. Checkout page confirms same: Shipping $8.95, Total $128.95. Free shipping is NOT available on every order; it requires $150+ minimum, contradicting the ad.

steps.summary: Built a cart in the store's agent checkout (UCP) with the ad's codes

verdicts.pageQuote: Free shipping on orders of $150.00 or more
verdicts.reason: The site limits free shipping to orders of $150.00 or more, contradicting free shipping on every order. The $120.00 order is also charged $8.95 shipping.

fix.summary: Remove the $150 minimum for free shipping so every order ships free as advertised.
fix.rationale: The ad promises free shipping on every order, but the funnel applies it only at $150 or more and charges $8.95 shipping on a $120 order, so the threshold is the mismatch to remove.
steps: Open Store admin > Shipping settings > Free shipping rate and change the minimum order amount from $150 to $0, removing the minimum-order condition.
Save the free shipping rate and confirm it is active for orders of all values.
Check by placing a $120 test order and confirming checkout shows $0 shipping instead of $8.95.
